title: プログラミング基礎
subtitle: Computer Programming Basic
educationalGoal: This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of the information design fundamentals in the Department of Management Information. In order to acquire the basic abilities of computer programming, students will be given a bird's-eye view of programming and an understanding of many of the basic terms and concepts of programming, such as branching, loops, functions, and objects.
advice: The purpose of this class is to learn the basics of program input, execution, and debugging through lectures, quizzes, and exercises for programming. The programming language uses Java, which is the most widely used for all purposes from embedded fields to servers. In the exercise, students will understand various control methods by Javascript by executing them on a web browser and visually obtaining the results. The web browser used in the class is Google Chrome, so be sure to install Google Chrome on your laptop and bring that laptop with you every time. In addition, students must submit weekly assignments to review each lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Students need to understand basic PC operation methods such as creating, deleting, moving, and copying files and folders, and editing and saving text files. Students need to bring their PC every time.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain variables, data types, and arrangement.
Be able to understand how to use branching, loops, and functions.
Be able to make the control programs that perform in a web browser using JavaScript.
Be able to collect variables and functions into objects and use them.
